name: St/P in FEZ
source:
This is a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fantasy_Earth:_Zero]Fantasy Earth: Zero[/url] mini adventure game featuring main scenarios involving tentacles and bestiality with orcs.
Girls who are defeated in battle succumb to every kind of violation from monsters and enemy soldiers.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038266.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fantasy_Earth:_Zero]《幻想大陆：Zero》[/url]迷你冒险游戏，主要剧情包含触手以及与兽人的兽交。
